svg.title: THE WORLD IS OURS — Zolboo
svg.desc: Zolboo, full-stack developer from Mongolia. TypeScript, Next.js, Supabase. A ukiyo-e style print: a great ASCII wave curls in front of a vermilion sun while ASCII waves roll across the bottom and sakura petals fall. 世界は我らのもの — THE WORLD IS OURS.
